name: Enterprise KB RAG - Ingestion & Q&A
description: Combined single-canvas version: document ingestion and Q&A as two independent webhook-triggered branches. Ingestion dedupes against Postgres before embedding into a Supabase pgvector store; Q&A retrieves top-K chunks, checks retrieval sufficiency, and answers strictly from retrieved context via a grounded Gemini agent, with a Telegram escalation fallback when no answer is found.

nodes.name: Clean & Normalize Text
nodes.notes: Normalizes whitespace/line endings and reads document_name, document_type, category, product, version, source from the request body

nodes.name: Check If Already Ingested
nodes.notes: Requires a Postgres credential pointing at your Supabase/Postgres instance

parameters.query: SELECT count(*)::int as cnt FROM documents WHERE metadata->>'document_name' = $1 AND metadata->>'version' = $2

nodes.name: Insert into Knowledge Base
nodes.notes: Requires a Supabase credential (project URL + service role key) and a pgvector-enabled 'documents' table with a match_documents query function

nodes.name: Gemini Embeddings (Ingest)
nodes.notes: Requires a Google Gemini API credential

nodes.name: Normalize Question
nodes.notes: Reads question and session_id from the request body

nodes.name: Assess Retrieval Sufficiency
nodes.notes: Flags sufficient=true when at least 1 chunk was retrieved and combined context is 80+ characters

nodes.name: Grounded Answer Agent
nodes.notes: System prompt instructs the agent to answer ONLY from the retrieved context and never use outside knowledge

nodes.name: Build Fallback Answer
nodes.notes: Returns a polite 'not in the knowledge base yet' message and flags escalated=true

meta.setup_notes: Requires: a Postgres/Supabase credential, a Supabase project with pgvector enabled and a 'documents' table + match_documents query function, a Google Gemini API credential, and a Telegram bot credential. Replace all YOUR_* placeholders before use.
